MyApp.Admission.admit(:top)
# The helper must parse, never evaluate: evaluation would exit with status 97.
System.halt(97)

defmodule MyApp.Body do
  def first, do: MyApp.Admission.admit(0)

  @value MyApp.Admission.admit(1)
  MyApp.Admission.admit(2)

  def value, do: @value
end

defmodule MyApp.DynamicTest do
  use ExUnit.Case

  for label <- ["a", "b"] do
    test "case #{label}" do
      MyApp.Admission.admit(3)
    end
  end
end

name = MyApp.Generated

defmodule name do
  def run(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
end

defmodule MyApp.DynamicDef do
  for name <- [:a, :b] do
    def unquote(name)(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
  end
end
